toolchain:
# Stable toolchain; changing the compiler invalidates the shared sccache.
[toolchain]
channel = "1.97.1"
# rust-analyzer is a test subject, not an editor convenience: the code
# editor's language-server suite drives the real binary and fails rather
# than skips without it. The rustup shim shadows any system package, so it
# has to come from the toolchain.
components = ["rustfmt", "clippy", "rust-src", "rust-analyzer"]
profile = "minimal"
